audience: shops and restaurants that run UPOS Cloud POS and want sales and customer data in an AI assistant

useCases.title: Review sales by department and category
useCases.text: Read the department and category sale report of one store for a date range. Ask the assistant which departments and categories sell most in that period.

useCases.title: Total the payments and tenders for a period
useCases.text: Read the transaction report of one store for a date range, with payments and tenders. Ask the assistant to total each tender type for the period.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their loyalty balance
useCases.text: Search the saved customers and open one record. Read the loyalty balances and programs of that customer before you answer a question.

useCases.title: Add a new customer or correct contact details
useCases.text: Create a customer record from the details you give. Update one record to change only the fields you pass.

useCases.title: Check the menu, tax and staff setup of a store
useCases.text: List the menu items, taxes and users of one store to check the setup. Open one user to read that staff record.
